subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core write external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's private visible-history store, or should OpenClaw keep this limited to transcript/session state until a safer integration boundary exists?
rationale: The user-facing desync is valid, but the proposed repair crosses third-party persistence ownership and may require opt-in configuration, schema handling, and live proof that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve guarded WebUI sync
options.body: Implement a narrow Open WebUI visible-history mirror with explicit detection, opt-in configuration if needed, live Docker/Open WebUI proof, and no automatic historical backfill without a separate repair path.

options.title: Keep transcript-only behavior
options.body: Document that Control UI sends update OpenClaw transcript/model context but do not update Open WebUI's rendered history.

options.title: Design an integration seam first
options.body: Keep this open until an API/plugin/integration boundary can own Open WebUI-specific storage writes outside the hot `chat.send` path.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded WebUI sync
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow Open WebUI visible-history mirror with explicit detection, opt-in configuration if needed, live Docker/Open WebUI proof, and no automatic historical backfill without a separate repair path.

likelyOwner.reason: The visible current-main blame for the implicated gateway send/request-context paths points to this recent area contributor.
